Maya Patel: Published the post-incident summary for the V2 runtime latency spike: https://internal.redwood/postmortems/2391012345
Maya Patel: TL;DR — a KV cache eviction bug combined with a fallback race caused ~3x p95 token latency for ~18 minutes. No customer data exposed.
Devon Li: Thanks Maya. Quick Q — where are the raw traces / flamegraphs? I couldn't find them in the doc.
Maya Patel: Devon Li: raw traces + flamegraphs are uploaded into the "evidence" section of the doc. Staging repro steps are under "repro and mitigations".
Devon Li: Got it. I'll take ownership of the cache-eviction fix. ETA: EOD Thu (03/26).
Sarah Kim: I'll own the rollout-policy change to tighten fallback ordering and add a canary gate. Plan to open PR by Monday.
Chao Zhang: I'll add a prefix-cache-pressure alert and a daily synthetic check at 03:00 PT. Assigning to myself, testing today.
Maya Patel: Action summary for visibility — Devon: cache eviction fix (EOD Thu), Sarah: rollout policy PR (Mon), Chao: alert + synthetic job (Fri). I'll own follow-up verification and the 7-day checkpoint.
Maya Patel: Ops follow-up meeting scheduled Fri 10:00 PT — calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood/evt/2391012345
ops-bot: Incident channel archived by Maya Patel. Postmortem published. Next checkpoint scheduled in 7 days.
Devon Li: noted. I'll paste the local repro steps + a short test plan into the doc once I can reproduce.
Sarah Kim: thanks — will link the PR and include rollout timeline in the doc when ready :thumbsup:
Chao Zhang: synthetic run looks good: `ok: 200 req/s, cache_hit: 85%` — will push alert config after one more run.
Maya Patel: Reminder: if you make changes that affect fallbacks please tag @oncall and update the "owners" table in the doc. 7-day checkpoint = 03/31 10:00 PT.
Devon Li: will do.
Maya Patel: Closing loop here — appreciate the quick turn. If anything else pops up, add it to the doc under "follow-ups" and mention me. :heart:
